service.title: 1. Service Overview
paragraphs: Transcendence is an online platform where users can compete in Tetris matches, chat in real time, and unlock achievements.
The service is free to access and use.

If the user does not accept these terms, they must stop using the service immediately.

account.outro: Transcendence may suspend or delete any account that violates these terms.

items: Post illegal, offensive, hateful, or discriminatory content

competitions.outro: Achievements are assigned automatically and have no monetary value.
